explanation: The can has two distinct material zones. The metallic rim on top is shiny and reflective, characteristic of tin-plated steel with moderate metallic properties. The body is mostly covered by a paper label which is non-metallic and has a slightly glossy printed finish. Averaging across the whole object, the metallic value should be moderate since most of the visible surface is paper label with some metallic rim showing. The roughness is moderate - the paper label has some gloss from printing but isn't perfectly smooth, while the metallic rim is relatively smooth.
